review_method: Editorial comparison of exact English and Italian workbook phrases and point/measure identifiers; no model discovery.
scope_note: A dependency or measure member supplies normative context. Only the 27 frozen ACN points are assessment targets.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: for the purposes referred to in point 1
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: ai fini di cui al punto 1
direct_target_references.source_text_en: For at least the relevant information and network systems, for the purposes referred to in point 1, remote access, perimeter system activities (e.g. routers and firewalls), significant administrative events, and successful or failed access to network resources, endpoints and applications are monitored to detect cybersecurity events.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: Point 1 defines the detection tools and purpose.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the organization referred to in point 1
direct_target_references.source_text_en: An up-to-date list of the personnel of the organization referred to in point 1 who have specific roles and responsibilities is maintained and made known to the competent organizational units of the NIS entity.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: The cybersecurity organisation referred to in point 1
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: dell’organizzazione per la sicurezza informatica di cui al punto 1
direct_target_references.source_text_en: The cybersecurity organisation referred to in point 1 includes the point of contact and their alternate, the CSIRT liaison and any alternates, as referred to in the determination adopted pursuant to Article 7, paragraph 6 of the NIS Decree.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: The risk assessment referred to in point 1
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: La valutazione del rischio di cui al punto 1
direct_target_references.source_text_en: The risk assessment referred to in point 1 is performed at planned intervals and in any event at least every two years, as well as whenever significant incidents, organizational changes or changes in exposure to threats and the associated risks occur.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: Point 1 defines the risk assessment that is timed here.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: The plan referred to in point 1
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: Il piano di cui al punto 1
direct_target_references.source_text_en: The plan referred to in point 1 is reviewed and, where appropriate, updated periodically and in any event at least every two years, as well as when significant incidents occur, incorporating the relevant lessons learned, or when exposure to threats and associated risks changes.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: Point 1 defines the incident plan that is reviewed here.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the policies referred to in measure GV.PO-01
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: delle politiche di cui alla misura GV.PO-01
direct_target_references.source_text_en: Within the NIS entity's risk management processes and in compliance with the policies referred to in measure GV.PO-01, a cybersecurity risk management plan is defined, implemented, updated and documented to identify, analyse, evaluate, treat and monitor risks.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: The reference names a whole policy measure, not point 1.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the risk assessment referred to in measure ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: della valutazione del rischio di cui alla misura ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: The supplier assessment sits within the named risk assessment measure.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the cybersecurity risk management plan referred to in measure GV.RM-03
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: al piano di gestione dei rischi per la sicurezza informatica di cui alla misura GV.RM-03
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: The reference names the whole risk management plan measure.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the results of the risk assessment referred to in measure ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: agli esiti della valutazione del rischio di cui alla misura ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.source_text_en: For at least the relevant network and information systems, in accordance with the results of the risk assessment referred to in measure ID.RA-05, multi-factor authentication solutions are used.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: The MFA point invokes the risk assessment measure.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the results of the risk assessment referred to in measure ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: agli esiti della valutazione del rischio di cui alla misura ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.source_text_en: For at least the relevant network and information systems, in accordance with the results of the risk assessment referred to in measure ID.RA-05, except where justified and documented regulatory or technical reasons apply, data stored on portable devices, including laptops, smartphones and tablets, and on removable media are encrypted using state-of-the-art protocols and algorithms considered secure.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: The encryption point invokes the risk assessment measure.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the plans referred to in measure ID.IM-04
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: nei piani di cui alla misura ID.IM-04
direct_target_references.source_text_en: In accordance with the business continuity and disaster recovery needs identified in the plans referred to in measure ID.IM-04, data and configuration backups are performed periodically and, for at least the relevant information and network systems, offline backup copies are also retained.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: Business continuity and recovery needs chiefly concern ID.IM-04 P1/P2; P3-P5 are whole-measure context, not separate criteria.

direct_target_references.reference_phrase_en: the results of the risk assessment referred to in measure ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.reference_phrase_it: agli esiti della valutazione del rischio di cui alla misura ID.RA-05
direct_target_references.source_text_en: For at least the relevant network and information systems, in accordance with the results of the risk assessment referred to in measure ID.RA-05, the usability of the backups made is periodically verified through restore tests.
direct_target_references.editorial_reason: The restore-test point invokes the risk assessment measure.
